 Mr.N.S.Deshpande, Advocate for petitioners  Mrs. M.A.Barabde, AGP for respondent Nos. 1 to 3.
Mr. V.N.Patre, Advocate for Respondent No.4  CORAM :

1] Heard Mr. N.
for the petitioners and Mr. Patre, learned counsel for the respondent no.4.

2] The application under Order 7 Rule 11 of CPC filed by the petitioners has been rejected by the impugned order dated 25.1.2019 (pg.27), being aggrieved by which, the present petition has been filed.

3] It is the contention of the petitioners that the suit, as filed, is hit by the provisions of Section 63 of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation, Resettlement Act 2013, and therefore, the application ought to have been allowed.

entities.text: Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation, Resettlement Act 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: 4] A perusal of the prayer clause indicates that the relief sought in the plaint is regarding the title of the (2) 56wp1274.19 respondent no.4 in respect of the land of Gat No. 122 purchased by his predecessor by the sale deed dated 25.1.1988 and the subsequent sale deed dated 26.10.2009 in favour of the respondent no.4 and the boundaries of the same.
Considering the relief claimed, the suit would clearly not be hit by the provisions of Section 63 of the said Act.
